roads.name: Marine Drive
words: Properly twisty: 19 curves in 2.4 miles, about 8 a mile.
From 78 to 331 ft, with 557 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
Homes line much of it: about 41 buildings a mile beside the road.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 40 km/h limit its curves ask for about 0.18 g.
